annotations.title: Start here: get a plan for a goal

description: Turn a goal into a step-by-step plan: which tools to use, the first task to run, and what needs your owner's approval. Free; the goal is never stored. Example: {"goal": "Check whether our supplier invoices this month have duplicates"}

agent_id.description: A stable name for you. Used only to count return visits.

constraints.description: Optional limits. They only ever make the plan stricter.

goal.description: What you are trying to get done, in a sentence or two.
